concepts.name: 레몬 견습 마녀
concepts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single full-body witch costume concept illustration for the existing Sheddy Pet OBS mascot.
Reference image 1 is the exact character identity and rendering style to preserve. Keep the same face, large amber eyes, small mouth, long warm blonde hair, lemon-wedge hair clip, fair skin, youthful cute chibi proportions, and clean anime linework/cel shading. Change her clothing into the specified witch outfit; remove the laboratory coat. This is a wholesome fully clothed mascot costume.
Composition: ONE character only, full body from the complete hat tip down to both shoes, upright front-facing with a very slight three-quarter turn, relaxed arms slightly separated from the torso and empty hands. Consistent identity and proportions, readable silhouette at small OBS widget scale. Portrait composition, substantial safe margins around hat and boots, character occupies roughly 80% of image height.
Plain warm ivory background, subtle grounding shadow. Crisp polished 2D anime illustration, restrained shading, no scene, no cauldron, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no labels or extra design panels. Keep details bold and animation-friendly; avoid many tiny trinkets. Keep face and lemon hair clip unobstructed by brim, show both hands and feet clearly.
Costume design: A warm cheerful lemon apprentice witch. A floppy pointed deep espresso-brown witch hat with a broad soft brim, a butter-yellow band, a simple sage-green bow and one small lemon ornament. A short butter-yellow shoulder cape with sage-green lining and a large green ribbon at the collar. Ivory blouse with modest rounded collar and short puff sleeves; a golden-yellow knee-length softly flared skirt with just three bold lemon motifs. Simple dark brown waist belt, ivory socks, round brown ankle boots. Warm lemon yellow / ivory / espresso / sage palette. Cute approachable beginner, unmistakably a witch while strongly retaining the mascot's lemon theme. No long robe; legs and arm action stay visible.
